intro: Tuesday brings workflow security checks, specialized document AI and broader Canadian tariff relief. A flood watch covers the North Shore Mountains, while November planning offers contemporary dance, electronic music, AI conversations and seasonal dining.

stories.title: GitHub starts checking workflow logs for secrets
stories.summary: GitHub’s public preview scans newly completed Actions logs for supported provider credentials, adding findings to repository security alerts. Eligible enterprise owners must enable the feature; existing logs are excluded, and preview alerts require checking the alert list directly.

stories.title: Claude Fable 5.2 joins Copilot’s model picker
stories.summary: GitHub is gradually rolling out Claude Fable 5.2 across supported Copilot clients and eligible paid plans. Business and Enterprise administrators must enable its policy; Anthropic retains prompts and outputs for safety classification by default, with exemptions for eligible enterprises.

stories.title: NVIDIA and Elith release Japanese financial personas
stories.summary: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan supplies one million synthetic records, each containing nine persona perspectives grounded in official statistics and public surveys. Its CC BY 4.0 licence permits commercial use, giving developers material for customer simulations and financial-AI evaluation without real customer records.

stories.title: Dharma extracts requested fields directly into JSON
stories.summary: Dharma introduced a two-billion-parameter model that accepts document images and an optional output schema. Its November walkthrough explains typed fields and nested invoice tables, giving developers a specialized approach to forms and contracts without first mapping a complete OCR transcript.

stories.title: Flood watch covers the North Shore Mountains
stories.summary: The River Forecast Centre upgraded the South Coast and several other coastal regions to a flood watch Monday, ahead of heavy Tuesday–Wednesday rain. Rivers may rise rapidly; keep storm drains clear, avoid swift riverbanks and never drive across flooded roads.

stories.title: Labour federation widens pressure on Highland Valley Copper
stories.summary: The BC Federation of Labour declared Highland Valley Copper’s mineral products subject to a hot edict, supporting more than 1,200 striking workers. It asks affiliated unions to refrain from handling those products in accordance with collective agreements and federation policy.

events.title: Three new dance works meet their audience
events.description: Inverso Productions’ Performance Research Project concludes with works in progress choreographed by Lesley Telford, Josh Martin and Vanessa Goodman. The evening showcases the cohort’s studio work and emerging dance artists; tickets are available through the organizer’s Showpass listing.

events.title: Hard techno takes over Main Street after dark
events.description: WE ARE RAVE programs five hours of hard techno and Schranz for its underground electronic night. Admission is restricted to people 19 and older with government-issued photo identification; ticket sales are final, with lineup announcements directed to the organizer’s updates.

meetups.date: 2026-11-21 · 10 a.m. · Nemesis Coffee Gastown, 302 West Hastings Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: AI Hangout makes room for practical coffee conversations
meetups.description: This independent gathering welcomes developers, founders, students and newcomers to discuss tools, projects and changes in their work. Registration is free, with coffee purchased separately; the organizer specifies informal conversation without presentations, sales pitches or a requirement to bring a project.

dining.date: 2026-11-10 · Bacchus, Wedgewood Hotel, 845 Hornby Street, Vancouver
dining.title: Bacchus pairs a winter menu with Nutcracker tea
dining.description: Bacchus’ new fall and winter dinner menu includes poached Nova Scotia lobster with caviar and yuzu, and dry-aged Fraser Valley duck. Its returning Nutcracker Afternoon Tea runs weekends from November 7 through January 16; reservations are recommended.
